style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF sweep for packshots, pale cast-stone info panels #EDEAE4 and #C9C6C0 for callout and variant screens, real timber deck and city stone for lifestyle frames, one material per shot
style.direction: clean technical athleisure commerce with a commuter tailoring edge
style.iconSystem: hairline single-weight line only: dashed outline traces and leader rules, small dots in the accent colour, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-balanced key at 5600K with bounce fill, low contrast, skimming side light only on texture macros, always one soft contact shadow that grounds the hem
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent technical athleisure commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper-white seamless ground #FFFFFF, pale cast-stone info panel #EDEAE4, deep ink-charcoal text and dark garment tone #22252A, and one sage-green accent #7C9A82; neutral-cool daylight-balanced studio light at 5600K; one modern geometric sans-serif; hairline single-weight line icons, dashed outline traces and leader rules only; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; matte technical-knit surface with true drape and visible topstitch, never glossy or shrink-wrapped; figure cropped from the collarbone or ribcage down with no face; stable silhouette scale and hem break; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy latex fabric.
noDrift: no glossy or shrink-wrapped fabric rendering
no visible face or model likeness
style.presentationRules: figure always cropped from the collarbone or ribcage down so no face appears, stable straight-on or slight 3/4 silhouette scale, wide-leg hem break readable in every frame, hand only when it shows a pocket or the waistband
style.surfaceSystem: matte technical-knit garment surface with visible topstitch against hard stone, timber and concrete grounds; no glossy or latex finish anywhere
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif, labels set as short right-aligned callouts on hairline leader rules, never dense body copy
